name: Tinker: Improved Emergency Heal changes Emergency Heal's cost and healing
contract: #1158: Improved Emergency Heal (504918) is a pair of percent spell modifiers whose class mask (0x80000000,0,0) selects only the Emergency Heal ranks. With it known, the native cost consumer must return 80% of the unmodified mana cost and the native healing consumer 120% of the unmodified heal.

steps.label: No cost modifier on Emergency Heal before the passive
No healing modifier on Emergency Heal before the passive
The passive cuts the Emergency Heal cost modifier to 80%
The passive raises the Emergency Heal healing modifier to 120%
Emergency Heal's real mana cost drops by 20%
Emergency Heal's calculated healing rises by 20%
